uncovered_crash_windows: SIGKILL/kernel/power loss, disk faults, and fsync semantics on the actual Kaggle filesystem.
Server accepts or executes a request before client response persistence; receipt remains unknown, with no server-side reconciliation or idempotency.
Timed-out daemon sender cannot be cancelled by Python and can remain active until transport return or process exit.
Crash after F response persistence but before HF starts; there is no resume flow.
Torn JSONL, partial request artifact, filesystem-full recovery, and interruption between request persistence and send-intent were not fault-injected.
Cross-host or network-mounted flock semantics were not checked.
Working-copy mutation after bootstrap readback but before runpy is not prevented by immutable execution.
Real backend/model artifact hashes, deployment state, and output quality remain unverified.
